response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS q WHERE q.ID = p.ID AND q.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.`ANA Pattern`) <> '' AND TRIM(q.`ANA Pattern`) <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A recorded ANA Pattern is non-NULL and nonblank; surrounding whitespace is ignored when comparing it with 'S'.
